title: 40-meter metallic object in the labyrinth

tellings.quote: There's a 40 meter object that's in that labyrinth that's in some vast corridor that's metallic. It's a UFO.
The 40 meter metallic object that's shaped like a tic tac
tellings.difference: Told second hand from Ben van Kerkwyk, citing a scan report, and adds that the object is shaped like a tic tac.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe the same 40-meter metallic object inside the Egyptian underground labyrinth.

as_told.title: 40-meter tic tac metallic object in Egyptian labyrinth

tellings.quote: That's in the labyrinth that Herodotus and Pliny the Elder and Ben Van Kerkwijk is now sort of reporting on.
tellings.difference: Cites Herodotus and Pliny the Elder as ancient sources for the labyrinth, and does not give the object's size.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the metallic object said to lie in the Egyptian labyrinth, which Van Kerkwijk reports on.

as_told.title: Egyptian labyrinth and metallic object reported in it

tellings.quote: I was like, "What about that 40-m long Tic Tac shaped object in the labyrinth and underneath Hawara?"
tellings.difference: Places it specifically under Hawara and credits Jeffrey and a blog post about the scan.
tellings.link_reason: The same 40-meter, Tic Tac shaped object in the labyrinth, reported via Ben Van Kerkwijk.

as_told.title: 40-meter Tic Tac shaped object under the Hawara labyrinth

plain: Deep in an underground labyrinth in Egypt, beneath the ancient site of Hawara, there is said to be a metallic object 40 meters long and shaped like a Tic Tac, a white oval like the mint, which Michels calls "a UFO." Michels raises it in several episodes, crediting a researcher named Ben van Kerkwijk, a scan report and a blog post about the scan, and a researcher named Jeffrey Drum, and he notes that the ancient writers Herodotus and Pliny the Elder described the labyrinth. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan repeats it second hand from van Kerkwijk, calling it "the 40 meter metallic object that's shaped like a tic tac."
